text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Since sitting down at my desk to craft a<n>new
training regimen for<n><chrname>, the
last few<n>hours have flown by. I'm about to take a<n>
break when...

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
Are you there, Trainer? It's Tazuna. You<n>have a
visitor. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It's Etsuko Otonashi from TwinkleMonthly. Would you happen to beavailable to talk at the moment?

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you working? I'm sorry to disturb<n>you.
choice_data_list:
Yes, I was just thinking up a new training
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A training regimen? Um, if you don't<n>mind, may I
take a look?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Pardon me...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Hm, I see. Amazing... Oh, but this<n>is...
Hmm!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you once again. That was truly<n>
fascinating!
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear your opinion on it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Mine? But I'm just a reporter. I'm not<n>sure my
thoughts would be especially<n>insightful...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
What an amazing attitude to have!<n>Absorbing
anything and everything you<n>can, almost like an
insatiable black<n>hole...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Then, with all due respect, I think it may<n>prove
beneficial to reconsider the shape<n>of the cleats
you've chosen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
With this running form, I think using<n>outer-rim
type cleats will alleviate some<n>of the burden on
the runner.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Also, it seems to me that stamina often<n>becomes
a point of concern for runners<n>around this time in
their careers.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And going off your most recent lap<n>times, it might
serve you well to increase<n>your number of ramp
training sessions...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...That's all I have to note. It's only a<n>layman's
opinion, but I hope it can be of<n>help in some small
way.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
She certainly has a lot to say, and her<n>
observations are all incredibly insightful!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
I always knew you were knowledgeable<n>about
racing, but you're a veritable<n>wellspring of
wisdom, Reporter<n>Otonashi!
choice_data_list: You could become a trainer yourself.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored to hear that... But I'm quite<n>happy
being a reporter.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: If I weren't a reporter, I...

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Don't you need to discuss the<n>magazines,
Reporter Otonashi?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah! I'm terribly sorry! It's unlike me<n>to forget
my priorities!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to take a look at these<n>magazines and
let me know what you<n>think of the
announcements for the<n>Twinkle Star Climax!
choice_data_list: Ah, was wondering what was in the bag.

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
There sure are a lot. And not just racing<n>
magazines either—there are Umamusume<n>fashion
and manga magazines, too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Right! And physical publications are only<n>a small
fraction of the whole<n>picture—we've written
feature articles<n>for websites, too.
choice_data_list:
All this and you're saying it's just a small
fraction?!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text: I was utterly taken aback as well!
choice_data_list:
It really makes the scale of this event hit home,
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If only I could redirect your kind<n>comments to the
many companies who<n>agreed to pitch in and help!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, we still have plenty more gas<n>in the
tank. The opening day of the<n>series is still a ways
away...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And we're hoping to use that time for<n>further
promotion. I want to create the<n>grandest racing
event—one that every<n>citizen will await with
bated breath!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Well, this series is going to determine<n>the
greatest, after all! I want to learn<n>from your
example, Trainer<n>
<username>, and<n>devote
myself fully to this cause!
choice_data_list: So I'm fully devoting myself to it as well?
So I'm fully devoting myself to it as well?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Naturally! ...Oop, look at the time!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
My schedule is packed with meetings for<n>this
project, so I need to get back to the<n>office right
away. Thank you for your<n>time today!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
There she goes. She blows in and out of<n>here like
a whirlwind...
choice_data_list: I hear you on that one...

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way, have you seen this?

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna hands me a magazine. Among<n>the lineup
of features covering<n>powerhouse runners is an
article on<n><chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
These are the top contenders for the<n>title of
"greatest." ...What do you think?
choice_data_list: To be honest, I'm ecstatic. But...

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text: But?
choice_data_list:
One day, I want to see an entire issue dedicated
to her!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! I know how you feel, though. An<n>article
this small does leave a little to be<n>desired.

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
Special Issue on <chrname>,<n>the
Greatest Umamusume! Hehe, I look<n>forward to
reading that someday. ♪

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure <chrname> will<n>emerge from
this series as more than a<n>mere contender.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
During our training session later that<n>day, I'm
bursting with even more<n>motivation than usual!
